name: @spiralclass/livekit-captions-agent
description: Server-side LiveKit worker for live class captions — joins each class-call room, subscribes to participant mic tracks, runs Deepgram STT, calls back to the web app for consent/language config and Anthropic translation, and publishes translated caption lines. Replaces the client-driven pipeline (see D-106). Deployed as a docker-compose service on the self-hosted LiveKit box, not imported by the web app.
